item.title: Japan Reveals 100 Biggest Internet Trends of 2026, Including Anime, Games & Memes
item.description: Japan’s annual Internet Buzzword 100 awards have revealed their 2026 nominees, featuring popular anime, video games, viral memes, and even the female version of Draco Malfoy that recently attracted copyright complaints from Warner Bros.

item.title: After God Manga Creator Leaves Shogakukan Following Sexual Abuse Scandal
item.description: After God manga creator Sumi Eno has announced that the series is moving from Shogakukan to rival publisher Futabasha, citing the controversy surrounding Shogakukan’s MangaOne platform and its decision to employ a creator convicted of a sexual offense.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Developers Surprised by Demand for Classic Turn-Based RPGs
item.description: The developers of Final Fantasy Resonance have expressed surprise at the game’s overwhelmingly positive reception, revealing that they originally designed it for longtime fans of Final Fantasy V and VI rather than expecting such widespread popularity.

item.title: Hideki Kamiya Wants to Make a “Truly Insane” Castlevania Game
item.description: Veteran Japanese game director Hideki Kamiya has expressed interest in taking control of Konami’s legendary Castlevania franchise, suggesting he would like to develop a particularly outrageous new installment if the publisher ever gave him permission.

item.title: Dead by Daylight’s Beautification of Feng Min Angers the Usual Suspects
item.description: Dead by Daylight might be just slightly less scary now that the developers have changed the face model for character Feng Min, sure to have some theorizing that developers might be realizing the profitability of attractive characters, as opposed to frighteningly “realistic” ones.

item.title: Muv-Luv Girls Garden Censors Character Designs in Global Release
item.description: The international release of Muv-Luv Girls Garden has sparked criticism after players discovered that several petite, youthful-looking female characters had been redesigned with larger breasts and more mature proportions, despite the game being fictional.

item.title: Warner Bros. Shuts Down YouTube Channel Over Female Draco Malfoy Fan Videos
item.description: Warner Bros. has confirmed issuing copyright strikes against a YouTuber creating AI-generated Harry Potter videos featuring a female version of Draco Malfoy (Malfoid), with 13 strikes resulting in the termination of a channel with approximately 13,000 subscribers.

item.title: Japan’s New AI Detects Thousands of Anime & Manga Piracy Sites With 90% Accuracy
item.description: Japan’s government is developing an AI-powered system to identify pirated anime and manga, with initial testing finding that up to 94% of websites flagged by the technology contained illegally distributed content.

item.title: Japan’s Shuri Castle Reopens 7 Years After Devastating Fire
item.description: Okinawa’s historic Shuri Castle has reopened its restored main hall to the public for the first time since a devastating fire in 2019, marking a major milestone in the recovery of one of Japan’s most important cultural landmarks.

item.title: Sony Denies GTA VI Refunds as Players Discover PlayStation’s Strict Download Policy
item.description: Some Grand Theft Auto VI players are reportedly having their refund requests rejected by Sony, with PlayStation Store’s longstanding policy preventing customers from receiving ordinary refunds once a game has been downloaded, even if they haven’t played it.

item.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan Tops Chinese Manga Rankings Despite Anime Lacking Official Release
item.description: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan has become an unexpected hit in China, topping Bilibili Comics’ new release rankings despite its anime adaptation having no official Chinese distribution, with unauthorized uploads attracting millions of views.

item.title: Atelier Resleriana Trend Revealing Swimsuits Underneath Clothing
item.description: A trend has swept over Japanese Twitter as players of Atelier Resleriana have been sharing photos of the female characters with your clothing being semi-transparent, revealing their swimsuit outfits underneath and sure to have observers establishing a new fetish in the process.

item.title: GTA VI Privacy Policy Allows Rockstar to Collect Players’ Addresses, Locations & Personal Info
item.description: Rockstar Games is attracting attention over the extensive personal information it can collect from Grand Theft Auto VI players, including real names, home addresses, phone numbers, location data, and purchasing habits, as highlighted by a viral social media post.

item.title: Japanese Bus Driver Suspended After Licking Handrails on Livestream
item.description: A Japanese bus driver has been removed from driving duties after a livestream showed him licking handrails and hanging straps inside a bus. His employer, Keikyu Bus, has apologized and confirmed that the vehicle has been disinfected.
